account: Swindon deployed Simply Readable to produce Easy-Read documents with AI, co-designed with residents with learning disabilities. The council reports document conversion in under 30 minutes and costs of 7–10 pence for material previously costing upwards of £600. Its return-on-investment estimates have not been independently checked. A separate tool provides translation. In a post of 1 December 2023, the council's head of emerging technology wrote that manual Easy Read cost about £120 a page and that the tool had not yet launched. UKAuthority reported on 1 December 2023 that the tool used Claude 2 for text and Stable Diffusion for images and that a council team would check and amend the outputs.

ai_role.statement: AI converts complex material into Easy-Read outputs through a council-built workflow. Residents influenced the design. The source reports time, cost, and access benefits, but does not establish measured comprehension or independence gains.

claim_basis: Sources: the deployer's report, the deployer's descriptive report and the deployer's news report. For the benefit itself, the cited sources include no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.

comparator.after: 7-10 pence per document (1 penny per page in another passage of the same account), made in under 30 minutes
comparator.against: Easy Read documents made by hand or bought from an Easy Read service
comparator.before: About £120 per A4 page, upwards of £600 for a complex 5-10 page document, and weeks of work
comparator.quote: Each A4 page cost around £120 and documents took weeks to complete, or social workers had to dedicate significant time to create them manually.

developer: Swindon Borough Council using Amazon Bedrock

evidence.citation: Council or project account published in the Local Government Association AI case-study bank. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.quote: Previously, a complex 5-10 page document could cost upwards of £600 to convert. With Simply Readable, costs have reduced to just 7-10 pence, delivering significant savings that can be redirected towards other critical social services.
evidence.title: Swindon Borough Council: Simply Readable, an AI easy-read solution

The author leads the council's emerging technology team and writes on the cloud vendor's blog; the post gives the council's own cost baseline and says that the tool was not yet launched.
evidence.quote: It can typically cost £120 ($150) to adapt content manually for a single page with just five lines and five images. An average document of five pages would take two weeks to adapt, and cost £500 ($750).
evidence.title: Swindon Borough Council makes vital public information more accessible using Amazon Bedrock

evidence.citation: UKAuthority, Swindon develops GenAI for Easy Read documents, UKAuthority, 1 December 2023. The trade outlet has no stake in the tool; its story repeats the council announcement and adds no reporting of its own on results.
evidence.quote: It uses two large language models - Anthropic's Claude 2 for analysing and summarising documents and Stability AI's Stable Diffusion for producing images from text and prompts - and a council team will maintain oversight of the outputs, amending them where needed.
